title: Linear regression prediction
instruction:

Training data:
- Years: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]
- Salaries: [30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75]

    y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])
    # Train model and predict
    pass
solution_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def predict_salary(years_experience):
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)
    pred = model.predict([[years_experience]])
    return int(round(pred[0]))

title: k-NN classification on iris-like data
instruction:

Classes: 0 = setosa, 1 = versicolor, 2 = virginica

solution_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

def predict_iris_class(features, k=3):
    X = np.array([
        [5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2],
        [4.9, 3.0, 1.4, 0.2],
        [6.2, 2.9, 4.3, 1.3],
        [5.5, 2.5, 4.0, 1.3],
        [6.3, 3.3, 6.0, 2.5],
        [5.8, 2.7, 5.1, 1.9],
    ])
    y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2])
    knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=k)
    knn.fit(X, y)
    pred = knn.predict([features])
    return int(pred[0])
